name: transitions-dev
description: Production-ready CSS transition snippets for web apps. Use when adding or reviewing UI motion for badges, dropdowns, modals, panel/page reveals, card resizes, number pop-ins, text/icon swaps, success checks, avatar-group hovers, and validation shakes. Supports namespaced commands: transitions reveal (list catalog), transitions review (audit project fit), and transitions apply (install the best-fit snippet with hooks and reduced-motion handling).
